{{Top|leg}}
"'''Jangoed'''" was a slang term used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. After [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] issued [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], more experienced bounty hunters warned the newer hunters to be cautious when hunting [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. If not, they ran the risk of being "[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jangoed]]"&mdash;[[Sai cha/Legends|beheading]] by a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
